title: Scientists Found a 6-Foot Shark That Glows in the Dark

scenes.text: A six-foot shark glows in the dark.
It is the kitefin shark, found off New Zealand.
It lives about 984 feet down, where no sunlight reaches.
In 2021 scientists confirmed it makes its own light.
It is the largest vertebrate known to glow, up to almost six feet long.
A whole shark, lit up in the dark.

description:
Scientists confirmed in 2021 that the kitefin shark glows in the dark.
It grows to almost six feet long, the largest known luminous vertebrate, and lives about 300 meters deep.
Would you dive down to see it?
first_comment: Would you rather swim with glowing sharks or glowing jellyfish?
